bullets: DRINKING WATER, ANYTIME, ANYWHERE - Aquatabs are the world's leading water purification tablet and the ultimate choice for portable water treatment tablets. Removes 99.9999% of Bacteria, 99.99% of Viruses, and 99.9% of Cysts (Giardia).

FEEL SAFE OUT THERE - Aquatabs are an excellent solution for purifying water while backpacking, camping, hiking, traveling, or in emergency survival situations. Simply add one 49mg Aquatabs tablet into .75-2 liters of water and wait 30 minutes.

GLOBALLY CERTIFIED - EPA registered and certified to NSF/ANSI standard 60, these water purification tablets are independently tested, offering peace of mind for pure drinking. Essential for survival gear and supplies, trusted globally for water safety.

ENJOY GREAT TASTING WATER EVERY TIME - Aquatabs-treated water has no unpleasant taste, color, or odor unlike iodine-based products. Pair Aquatabs water purifying tablets with a water filtration system to treat water from sediment heavy sources.

GEAR UP AND GO - Aquatabs are tactical gear that is affordable and dependable, providing a cost-efficient solution for water purification. Ideal for camping gear, hiking essentials, and prepper supplies, Aquatabs ensures drinking water anytime, anywhere. Expiration Date: August 2030
